body.x: [Pipeline Position] Senior Research Scientist I (Kenya Country Office) [Based in Nairobi]
***This is a pipeline position created to prepare for anticipated hiring needs. Final hiring decisions will be made following internal review processes.***

We are seeking a Senior Research Scientist I for a 2-year-regular position (renewable) to work within Kenya Country Office at the International Vaccine Institute in Nairobi, Kenya. (Duty station: Nairobi, Kenya)

IVI has dramatically expanded its activities by integrating several new vaccine projects at different stages of development with various stakeholders. Further expansion will continue by identifying new partnerships and collaborations requiring in-depth analysis of the strategic and scientific value of proposed projects, translational implementation and follow-up of the selected projects in close collaboration with the different units and departments of IVI. Such activities require the leadership of a fully dedicated person.
Pursue engagement in ongoing activities of existing projects.
Develop a vision, strategy, and implementation plan for the Program to achieve organizational-level goals.

Ensure coordination of activities across projects and identify opportunities to leverage resources; define roles and responsibilities across projects that are necessary to most effectively deliver program goals.

Provide guidance to project teams and ensure each project has adequate budget and resources and monitor progress of the projects, identify changes in scope, schedule and cost and adjust accordingly; assist teams in risk management and development of mitigation plans as needed.
Publish high quality publications with impact.
2. Develop agenda for future funding to advance program objectives
Provide analysis and recommendations to the Unit Head, Director General and Business Development Director on strategic and scientific, business value and feasibility of implementation of new projects
Hand over projects to units and departments for translational implementation (e.g., CARE, EPIC, Science) or lead projects as necessary
Support activities of IVI Europe/Africa as requested
Collaborate with LT, PL’s, PM as well as external collaborators to identify funding opportunities, in particular to diversify IVI’s portfolio of funders
Lead the writing of compelling and insightful grant proposals which fulfill donor’s needs and IVI’s objectives.
3. Develop and manage external collaborations within Unit
Develop and maintain alliances and manage key stakeholders with a long-term impact on the success of the program.
Identify new key stakeholders who will advocate for the Program and enhance the probability of success
Integrate a business development approach into the program to expand the scope of activities and partnerships.
Ensure coordination with donors, partners, contractors, etc.
Participate in IVI meetings, seminars, and science workshops as a participant and speaker
Represent IVI in international conferences as appropriate
4. Serve as Project Technical Lead on one or more projects within the program fulfilling the roles and responsibilities as outlined in the project charter.
Phd Biochemical Engineering/Life Sciences or related fields
At least 14 years of international experience in vaccine development (science, preclinical and clinical development) — experience in vaccine development, regulatory strategy, and grant preparation
Capacity to assess strategic and scientific value of new projects
Management and communication skills in international settings
Written skills for concept notes, grants, reports and publications
Able to travel internationally as requested
Capacity to assess, initiate and secure projects of strategic and scientific new projects for IVI and Global health
Fluent in English (spoken, written), other languages as a plus (French, Korean)
***IVI welcomes applications from all sections of the community. We encourage women to apply, especially from countries that are currently under-represented within IVI.***
